description: A 0.12345 rollout puts the threshold at 1234.5. Allocation bucket 1234 is below it and is inside the rollout. A port that floors the threshold to 1234 excludes this context, so this is the case that catches truncated threshold math.

probe.why: Half a bucket below a fractional threshold: inside under the float comparison, outside under a floored one. Immune to floating-point dust.
